title: 26 U.S.C. 752, Treatment of certain liabilities (U.S. Code 2024 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, United States Code

passages.question: What is each partner's liability share, and does the fall in payables create a deemed distribution?
passages.excerpt: Any decrease in a partner's share of the liabilities of a partnership, or any decrease in a partner's individual liabilities by reason of the assumption by the partnership of such individual liabilities, shall be considered as a distribution of money to the partner
